SPEC SYSTEM (Specs/README.md): IDs REQ-<DOMAIN>-<sec>.<n>, permanent, never renumbered; dead REQs go to the file's Withdrawn table (body keeps a 'stricken' or '*(Withdrawn date ...)*' stub). Linkage ONLY via test names beginning with REQ IDs; Src and migrations carry NO REQ annotations by design (retired 2026-07-31, do not flag absence).
